summary: Added a simple monochrome B mark to the Android adaptive icon for optional system-themed launcher icons. The standard full-color BOOHTACORD icon and pre-API-26 density icons are unchanged.

checks.name: Adaptive icon resource contract
checks.observation: Focused regression test verifies the adaptive monochrome reference, vector viewport, opaque white mask color, and even-odd cutouts.

checks.name: Android release APK resource compilation
checks.observation: Gradle assembled app-release.apk (107833098 bytes). AAPT2 dump of res/BW.xml contains background, foreground, and monochrome adaptive-icon layers.

checks.name: Pixel 7 themed launcher rendering
checks.observation: The connected Pixel 7 remains on the previously installed 1.0.9+2014 APK; no launcher setting or installed package was changed. The user-visible themed-icon rendering is not yet verified.

checks.name: Installed macOS and Windows icon acceptance
checks.observation: No application package or installation state changed on these platforms during this Android-only resource task.

remaining: Install a signed release with the same signing identity on Pixel 7, enable themed icons using a reversible user-visible launcher setting, and inspect the generated monochrome icon. Verify the installed macOS/Windows icons in their native launchers.
